IpancakeRouter02 router reference assigned in the constructor.
Address of the AU/WETH pair created in the constructor; compared against recipient in _transfer.
Total token supply, minted to the owner in the constructor and used as the base for max-tx math.
Flag that gates transfers to the pancake pair; one-way switch set by AntiWhale.
Maximum amount per transaction; initialised in constructor and changed by setMaxTxPercent.
Owner address stored by Ownable and read by owner(); governs onlyOwner protected functions.
Initialises name/symbol/decimals/supply, sets balances of owner, computes max tx amount, deploys the pancake pair and sets exclusions.
External transfer entry point; forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Spender-driven transfer that also validates and reduces the allowance of msg.sender.
Sets the allowance of a spender for msg.sender via _approve.
Increases the spender allowance of msg.sender by addedValue and stores it through _approve.
Decreases the spender allowance of msg.sender by subtractedValue after a balance check.
onlyOwner function that permanently opens selling by setting _sellingOpen = true.
onlyOwner function toggling the max-tx exemption of an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner function recomputing _maxTxAmount as a percentage of _totalSupply using SafeMath mul/div.
Internal transfer logic enforcing ownership, max-tx and selling gates, updating _balances and firing hook callbacks.
Internal allowance writer that validates addresses and updates _allowances.

SafeMath mul/div arithmetic in setMaxTxPercent scaled by the owner-supplied maxTxAmount.
Arithmetic computing 1000000000000 * 1e18 supply and the initial 1% max tx amount in the constructor.
